installinstructions.Linux:
Requires Linux on x86-64 with gcc (or clang), make and curl. Remove or disable the Python version of this plugin first, both register an architecture named `LoongArch64`.

1. Clone this repository and `cd` into it.
2. Build: `make BN_INSTALL=/path/to/binaryninja` (the directory containing `libbinaryninjacore.so.1`, default `~/binaryninja`). This downloads the `binaryninjacore.h` matching your Binary Ninja version.
3. Install: `make install BN_INSTALL=/path/to/binaryninja`
4. Restart Binary Ninja. The log shows `LoongArch64 architecture loaded (2031 opcodes)`.

After updating Binary Ninja, rebuild with `make clean header all install BN_INSTALL=/path/to/binaryninja`.
